review: 702.90b-1: the base variant carried the attacker choice as its delta; fixed Contagious Nim as the attacker in decisions and emptied the base delta.
702.90c-1: the base variant carried the attacker choice as its delta; fixed Contagious Nim as the attacker in decisions and emptied the base delta.

skipped.reason: cannot be illustrated with cards Forge implements: it needs an infect source dealing damage from a zone other than the battlefield, and no Forge card gives infect to a spell or to a card in a hand, graveyard, library or exile (infect appears only as a creature keyword or is granted to creatures on the battlefield); the infect damage outcome itself is covered by 702.90b-1, 702.90c-1 and 702.90d-1, and the same rule for wither is illustrated by 702.80c-1

scenarios.title: Damage from an infect source to a player gives poison counters instead of life loss
decisions: A attacks player B with Contagious Nim only.
B declares no blockers; combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: infect_attacker
variants.expected: B receives 2 poison counters and B's life stays 20.

variants.label: plain_attacker
variants.delta: A attacks with Grizzly Bears (2/2) instead of Contagious Nim.
variants.expected: B loses 2 life, so B's life becomes 18. B has no poison counters.

scenarios.title: Combat damage from an infect source to a creature is dealt as -1/-1 counters
decisions: A attacks player B with Contagious Nim only.
B blocks Contagious Nim with Hill Giant.
No spells or abilities are used; combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: infect_attacker
variants.expected: Contagious Nim deals 2 damage to Hill Giant as two -1/-1 counters: Hill Giant is a 1/1 with 0 damage marked and stays on the battlefield. Hill Giant deals 3 damage to Contagious Nim, which is destroyed. B's life stays 20.

variants.label: plain_attacker
variants.delta: A attacks with Grizzly Bears (2/2) instead of Contagious Nim, and Hill Giant blocks it.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears deals 2 damage to Hill Giant, which has 2 damage marked, no counters, and stays a 3/3. Hill Giant deals 3 damage to Grizzly Bears, which is destroyed. B's life stays 20.

scenarios.title: An infect source that left the battlefield still deals its damage as counters
decisions: A casts Tainted Strike targeting Mogg Fanatic, tapping Swamp; it resolves and Mogg Fanatic gains infect until end of turn (unless the variant says A does not cast it).
A activates Mogg Fanatic, sacrificing it as a cost, targeting Hill Giant. Mogg Fanatic is in the graveyard before the ability resolves.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.

variants.label: infect_granted
variants.expected: The 1 damage comes from a source that had infect as it left the battlefield: Hill Giant gets one -1/-1 counter, a 2/2 with 0 damage marked.

variants.label: not_granted
variants.delta: A does not cast Tainted Strike.
variants.expected: Mogg Fanatic had no infect. Hill Giant has 1 damage marked, no counters, and stays a 3/3.

variants.label: player_target
variants.delta: Mogg Fanatic's ability targets player B instead of Hill Giant.
variants.expected: B receives 1 poison counter and B's life stays 20. Hill Giant is unchanged.

scenarios.forge_notes: Relies on Forge using the last known information of the sacrificed Mogg Fanatic for infect; the sacrifice cost is paid before the ability resolves.
